<thought>We need a template that forms a sulfonamide (S–N bond) in the forward reaction. Using the functional group list, “sulfonamides” is the functional group formed. I will search the template catalog for templates that form a sulfonamide functional group and create an S–N bond, using a representative sulfonamide product SMILES (benzenesulfonamide).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "bonds_formed": ["S-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
